lines: this. is.
sparta!
WHEN YOU'RE WASHING DISHES AND SOMEONE ADDS MORE
WHEN THE TOILET PAPER IS HANGING ON THE WRONG WAY
IF I HEAR ABOUT ONE MORE CHILD
BEING LEFT ALONE IN A HOT VEHICLE . . . !!
NO, I WOULD NOT LIKE TO TAKE YOUR BRIEF SURVEY
STOP...SAYING... YOLO!!!!
BUCKET BLOOD CHALLENGE WITH DEAD HEADS THISSS ISS SPARTA
WHO ATE ALL THE LEFTOVERS?!
TO THE HANDICAPPED PERSON WHO STOLE MY BAG YOU CAN HIDE, BUT YOU CAN'T RUN
NO! SELFIES!
WHEN YOU ACCIDENTALLY CLICK ON AN AD AND IT TAKES YOU TO THE APP STORE
ARRIVING AT AN ALL YOU CAN EAT BUFFET WHEN YOU HAVEN'T HAD ANYTHING TO EAT ALL DAY
THAT MOMENT WHEN YOU STEP ON A LEGO

AT 5:30 IN THE MORNING??
MY FACE WHEN SOMEONE TURNS ON A TAP WHEN I'M HAVING A SHOWER

THAT FACE YOU MAKE WHEN YOU ACCIDENTALLY CHOMP DOWN ON YOUR TONGUE.

meaning.meaning_en: This meme expresses an intense, aggressive outburst of frustration or anger, often in response to a minor annoyance or a specific trigger. The first text box is used to describe the situation or the thing that caused the rage, while the second box is typically left empty or contains a short, emphatic exclamation to complete the 'This is Sparta!' shout.
meaning.meaning_de: Dieser Meme drückt einen intensiven, aggressiven Ausbruch von Frustration oder Wut aus, oft als Reaktion auf eine kleine Belästigung oder einen bestimmten Auslöser. Das erste Textfeld wird verwendet, um die Situation oder die Sache zu beschreiben, die den Zorn ausgelöst hat, während das zweite Feld oft leer bleibt oder eine kurze, betonte Ausrufung enthält, um den 'Das ist Sparta!'-Schrei zu vervollständigen.
